dog.description_text:
Perseus is a 2 year old Great Pyrenees (maybe Border Collie too?) mix weighing around 60 pounds, and if you ask him, there are no strangers, only friends he hasn't met yet. Whether it's another dog or a neighbor on the sidewalk, Perseus is always ready to say hello with a wagging tail and his signature sweet smile.

This lovable guy adores people just as much as he loves other dogs. He's happiest soaking up attention, rolling over for endless belly rubs, snuggling up with his favorite humans, or simply people watching in the hopes that someone will stop to tell him how handsome he is.

Perseus has been making great progress with his leash skills and house training, and he'll thrive with an adopter who understands, or is excited to learn about, the Great Pyrenees breed. Like all dogs, he'll need time to settle into a new home, and with a patient family to guide him through that transition, he's sure to become an incredible companion.

Registered adopters interested in Perseus can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you’re not registered yet, you can do it at hbrdogs.com.
